key_insight: ProofCoder improves automated Rocq proof synthesis by reasoning continuously and revising proofs using proof-assistant feedback rather than following a rigid tactic-generation loop.
engineering_relevance: Agent-controlled inspection, repair, and backtracking could reduce the effort and cost of formally verifying software.
method: Treat proof synthesis as a coding-agent task with continuous reasoning.
Use Rocq feedback to guide information gathering, proof-state inspection, revision, and backtracking.
Construct and repair proofs at tactic-level or whole-proof granularity.
evidence_signal: On 280 AutoRocq Benchmark tasks, the best-performing configurations increased proof success from 47% to 60% versus AutoRocq—a 27.7% relative improvement—at approximately half the cost.
watch_item: Results are limited to the reported Rocq benchmark; generalization to other proof assistants and verification workloads remains unestablished.
paper_title: ProofCoder: Continuous Reasoning for Automated Software Verification
